scope: Pilot: bring Inside-Success/graph-retrieval's documentation into AES canonical's declared layout (.agentic/repo.yaml: wiki/index.md entry, docs/architecture, docs/decisions, docs/plans) as AES's first retrofit of an existing repository; acceptance by reachability from the wiki and a cold-reader test, not file count.

fact_evidence.existing_implementation_obstacle: The docs exist and work; the problem is navigation and layout, not an implementation that must be torn down.
fact_evidence.reproduced_failure: reach.py on graph-retrieval main (2026-10-07): 97 tracked .md, 56 reachable from wiki/index.md, 41 unreachable.
fact_evidence.identified_fix: No fix is identified yet: which unreachable files are loader-read instruction files or fixtures versus orphans is unclassified, and the target layout is a pilot contract never applied to an existing repo.
fact_evidence.machine_consumed_planning_handoff: The plan is read by Brian and agents; no machine consumer ingests it.
fact_evidence.shared_contract_mutation: The work adopts the existing .agentic/repo.yaml layout as-is; it does not change that contract. The repo's own doc tooling is repo-local.
fact_evidence.persistent_migration: Files move within git; no database or data-store migration.
fact_evidence.governed_registry: PROJECT_GRAPH.json and other registries are not edited.
fact_evidence.consequential_external_mutation: Changes are PRs to a git repository, reversible by revert; nothing is published or sent outward.
fact_evidence.answer_only: Brian asked for the work to be done and planned ('lets make our plans moving forward company plans complaint'), not for an answer.
fact_evidence.continuity_beyond_session: Pilot, AES retrofit proposal, then rollout to further repos spans more than one session.
fact_evidence.one_writer: One Claude session holds the only claim (agentic-engineering-system-canonical:shaping-aes-brownfield-docs); graph-retrieval has no other claims.
fact_evidence.reversible: Every change is a git commit in a repository with history; each moved file is restorable by revert or git show.
fact_evidence.boundary_known: AES Decision 0010 and the v0.2 design thesis declare retrofit of existing repositories a non-goal with no procedure; .agentic/repo.yaml pins a wiki_methodology entrypoint (docs/architecture/README.md) that no longer exists, so the target boundary still needs defining.

rationale: One writer, reversible, and continuing across sessions while the layout boundary for an existing repository is still undefined: durable_solo, with bounded-design to define the target before implementation.
